releases.notes:
### alpha-0.0.5 release notes:

Golam Entity ->
*   Interaction with items set a cooldown.
*   Add sounds to golam repair action.

Blacksmith Golam ->
*   Can now take in double chest inventory



Harvester Golam -> 
*   Give it a tool and assign it to saplings or crops. Once they'll grow, harvester golam will harvest the ressource and replant it !

*   Assignables blocks :

    *   When an axe is given : Vanilla Saplings (excluding Mangrove, WIP!), Red and Brown mushrooms, Crimson and Warped Fungus, Bamboo, Golam Interface (empty, #minecraft:axes).
    *   When a hoe is given : Vanilla crops, cacao beans, cactus, sugar cane, Golam Interface (empty, #minecraft:hoes).
    
Golam Core -> 
*   Reworked Assignations logic, more coherent and guiding utilisation.
*   Default availables assignations for golams when interacted with golam core set to PASS.

### alpha-0.0.3 release notes :

Golam Interface → Can now be powered by redstone. When powered, exporting from an empty Golam Interface is disabled. When unpowered, it triggers a request to assigned Golams to export items, preventing Deliverer Golams from ticking while waiting for items.

Deliverer Golam → When exporting from an empty Golam Interface, it will no longer take items that don’t match any assigned interface.

Golam Entities → Now drop their inventory and equipment when picked up or killed.

releases.notes:
## Implemented : 
---

### - Entities :

* Cartographer Golam (80%) -> can be given a naturally generated map (buried treasure, mansion or monument) by right clicking on the golam. Once it got a map, right-clicking on the golam with a golam core will :

     * Make the golam look in the direction of maps poi coordinates . If poi is not reachable, it will be the only action done (will have an animation later)
     * Make the golam move to the maps poi coordinates. (useful with buried treasures, the golam will reach the coordinates of the treasure and stand on the block above the chest)

releases.notes:
## Implemented : 
---

### - Entities :

* Unassigned Golam -> Base entity, can be upgrade with smithing templates matching profession.
* Blacksmith Golam (40%) -> Restock basalt from assigned interfaces and repair others golams
* Cartographer Golam (10%) -> act as Unassigned Golam
* Deliverer Golam (80%) -> Take items from empty interface and deliver them to assigned matching item interfaces.
* Guard Golam (40%) -> Attack hostile Mobs, follow others non guards golams.

### - Items :

* Golam Core -> Base item of the game, made of a smooth basalt block, a calcite block and an amethyst shard in a smithing table.
* Golam Upgrade template -> A template used for crafting Golam Professions Upgrade Templates. Made with a smooth basalt block, a golam core, and an amethyst shard in a smithing table.
* Golam Professions Upgrade Templates -> a set of items used to upgrade Golams. Made from Golam Upgrade Template an item/block corresponding to the profession and an amethyst shard in smithing table.

### - Blocks :
* Golam Interface (60%) -> Used for Golams to refill their inventory. can be assigned to golams by click on Golam and the interface.
